summary: Preserve decision DSL history and adopt the published native worktree inventory repair

delivery.outcome: Preserve schema-valid advisory strings and enforce append-only history across mixed bare and fenced DSL records; publish the material patch and its release projections through protected delivery. Distribute the independently approved Worktrees 0.5.4 artifacts so native Windows inventory works after adoption. Keep first-allocation authority checks in both native CI and ordinary test discovery without a duplicate nested whole-suite timeout.
nonGoals: Grant review or merge authority through decision logs.
Change trusted publication, leases, other parser semantics or unrelated workstreams.

architecture.decision: Encode advisory strings as JSON string literals and decode them strictly. Extract bare and fenced DSL records in document order without counting fence bodies twice. Keep legacy valid records byte-stable and join the patch version projections to this implementation. Keep the installed runtime parser byte-for-byte synchronized through the declared package synchronizer and exercise both variants in the same regressions. Adopt Worktrees 0.5.4 from its immutable independently approved merge commit; generate the source dependency lock and vendor bytes from verified Git objects, then check native POSIX and Windows CLI inventory. Preserve all 24 FreshBootstrapTest authority-boundary cases in the protected adoption-lock job as a direct suite invocation. Remove only the duplicate aggregate wrapper from the legacy migration suite; normal root pytest already collects all 24 cases separately. Keep existing test assertions, production gates and bounded CI job timeouts unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material patch through protected delivery; preserve prior history and do not mutate old logs.

validation.evidence: Schema-valid strings containing quotes, backslashes and newlines round-trip without changing plain legacy records.
Both record orders, record removal and mutation are checked across mixed Markdown formats without double counting.
Hub governance and release consistency pass; Linux and Windows gates plus independent exact-head approval govern protected publication.
Published dependency revision and hashes bind both vendor artifacts; actual inventory CLI preserves native Windows and POSIX path styles.

The protected shell entrypoint runs all 24 unchanged FreshBootstrapTest cases directly; root discovery retains those cases and removes only their duplicate wrapper. No timeout increase, gate retirement or assertion removal.
